description: This file defines the ProjectModel class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin API module. The class models project data for the API, including serialization and normalization functionalities, and maps to the Project entity.

classes.name: ProjectModel
classes.description: A data transfer object for representing Project entities in the API, enabling serialization and normalized output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ProjectModel with a Project entity and sets up attribute filters and names for serialization.
